description: Zakat on wealth: 2.5 % of net zakatable wealth (cash, bank, investments, trade goods, money owed to you, gold and silver, minus debts due now) when it reaches the nisab: the value of 85 g of pure gold (default) or 595 g of silver. Gold weight is converted to pure gold by karat (24/22/21/18). You give today's gold/silver price per gram in your currency: nothing is fetched from the network. An estimate only; consult a scholar. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/zakat-calc/

currency.description: Currency label for the summary (e.g. JOD).

goldPricePerGram.description: Price of 1 g of pure (24k) gold. Needed for the gold nisab and to value gold.

receivables.description: Money owed to you that you expect back.

silverPricePerGram.description: Price of 1 g of silver. Needed for the silver nisab and to value silver.

tradeGoods.description: Value of goods held for sale.
